title: Towards Reversible Forgetting: Managing Obsolete Knowledge in Continual Enterprise AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.18177v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual learning has traditionally treated forgetting as a failure, emphasizing preservation of previously acquired knowledge as environments evolve. We argue that this objective is incomplete for enterprise AI agents operating in non-stationary environments, where customers, policies, tools, workflows, regulations, and market conditions change over time. Indiscriminate retention can allow obsolete knowledge to influence decisions, creating negative transfer and operational risk. We therefore propose reversible forgetting: a conceptual framework with three operational memory states: active, dormant, and retired, and a reactivation transition that can restore dormant knowledge when its relevance returns. translated_title: 迈向可逆遗忘：持续企业AI代理中的过时知识管理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18177v1 公告类型：新 摘要：持续学习传统上将遗忘视为一种失败，强调在环境演变中保留先前获得的知识。我们主张，对于在非平稳环境中运行的企业AI代理，这一目标是不完整的，因为客户、政策、工具、工作流程、法规和市场条件会随时间变化。不加区分地保留知识可能使过时知识影响决策，从而造成负迁移和运营风险。因此，我们提出可逆遗忘：一个概念框架，具有三种操作记忆状态：活跃、休眠和退役，以及一个重新激活转换，可以在相关性回归时恢复休眠知识。我们将该框架实例化为一个滞后可逆记忆控制器，它积累相关性证据，使用不对称阈值防止状态振荡，在影子模式下测试重新激活，并通过策略门控退役。
tldr: 本文提出“可逆遗忘”框架，通过活跃、休眠和退役三种记忆状态及滞后控制器，使企业AI代理能动态管理过时知识，避免负迁移并支持知识恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "reversible forgetting" framework with active, dormant, and retired memory states and a hysteretic controller, enabling enterprise AI agents to dynamically manage obsolete knowledge, avoid negative transfer, and support knowledge reactivation.
